title: Oozing Luscious Winey Tomato Ramekin Ramen
description: A festive Slovakian dish featuring tomato and render-fat in a ramekin bowl for an indulgent and snappy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the rendered pork fat and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in the oregano and cook for another minute.
Break open the tomatoes and add to the pan. Let them release their juice.
Pour in the wine and bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Simmer until slightly reduced, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt to taste. Taste test and adjust as necessary.
Divide the mixture evenly into ramekin bowls.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
